title: CIDG seizes P2.42M worth of illegal ‘ukay-ukay’ in Bacolod City

blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY, NEGROS OCCIDENTAL, Philippines — Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) operatives arrested a 39-year-old man and seized 60 bales of undocumented imported used clothing, locally known as “ukay-ukay,” valued at P2.42 million, during a joint law enforcement operation in Barangay Cabug here on Monday afternoon, Nov. 16.
